name: Sanroku Trail Series
description: Sanroku Trail Series is a WordPress theme for a trail-running race series that sells entries: a flush film-grain photograph with a vertical headline and the season's races as ruled rows directly under it, a horizontal season strip, a dark course band with a dotted-leader aid-station accordion, a six-cell mandatory kit table, a ribbon-day milestone row, a full-width fee ledger and one way to enter. Archivo and Inter Tight on warm grey with one olive accent.

fonts.role: display: headings, numerals, the wordmark and the vertical headline (variable 100-900, Latin subset)
text: body copy, rows, navigation and table cells (variable 100-900, Latin subset)
zh-TW headings, subset to the characters of the Traditional Chinese sample text
